LESSON: BOOK HANDLING SKILLS (1 1/

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 4.1: Book handling Skills (1 1/

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Book handling Skills (1 1/. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how to turn pages books on shelves?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate how to handle books properly
2. Enjoy participating in book handling activities.
3. Participate in storing books properly in and out of school. on each page. to arrange books on shelves. 31 demonstration on how to cover books and imitate. hold a book appropriately whenever opportunities arise. holding the book up-side-up, sing songs and recite poems and rhymes on how to hold books properly. arrange objects from top to bottom on a page.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate how to handle books properly
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate how to handle books properly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Enjoy participating in book handling activities.

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Book handling Skills (1 1/.
2. Explain Book handling Skills (1 1/ to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Book handling Skills (1 1/.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate how to handle books properly
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Book handling Skills (1 1/. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how to turn pages books on shelves?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate how to handle books properly
2. Enjoy participating in book handling activities.
3.
